answer: An agent economy resists sybils by forcing each peer to wander a unique proof path no copy can mirror. Every agent stamps its claims on a basalt ledger of irreversible attestations tied to staked identity. A clone that tries to mirror another's path fails the signature check and is ejected. To flood the system an attacker must wander a fresh, costly path per identity, burning stake each time. The per-clone cost dwarfs any reward, so honest agents dominate.
